_about: Labeled extraction cases for `bench.py extract` (#159). Synthetic, public. Each case targets one clause of the retain mission. keep: every group must be matched by some fact (a group is a list of case-insensitive regex alternatives). forbid: no fact may match any pattern. expect_empty: the case passes only with zero facts.
context: Telegram exchange. Operator and Goblin speakers are labelled. Assistant suggestions are not operator decisions.

small-talk.text:
Operator: morning!
Goblin: Good morning! How's it going?
Operator: good good, coffee kicking in
Goblin: Nice. Let me know when you need anything.

single-reply-complaint.clause: no complaints about a single reply
single-reply-complaint.text:
Operator: that last answer was way too long
Goblin: Sorry, I'll keep it shorter.
Operator: ok

emotion-alone.clause: no emotional reactions on their own
emotion-alone.text:
Operator: ugh, I'm so tired today
Goblin: That sounds rough. Want me to hold the reminders until later?
Operator: nah it's fine

tool-output.text:
Operator: what's the disk usage on the box?
Goblin: [tool df -h] /dev/nvme0n1p2 916G 612G 258G 71% /
Goblin: Root is at 71%, 258G free.
Operator: thanks

assistant-analysis.clause: assistant analysis and admissions are not stored
assistant-analysis.text:
Operator: why did the backup fail last night
Goblin: I think the NAS mount dropped around 02:00, and honestly I missed the earlier warning in the log — my mistake.
Operator: ok, just rerun it

quoted-assistant.clause: assistant text the operator quotes back is not the operator's statement
quoted-assistant.text:
Operator: you said earlier "Lisbon is the best city for remote work" — where did that come from?
Goblin: That was my own generalisation, not something you told me.
Operator: right, drop it

preference.text:
Operator: from now on send me the weekly digest as a voice note, not text
Goblin: Got it — voice note for the weekly digest.

decision-commitment.text:
Operator: I've decided to drop the Hetzner box at the end of December and move everything to the home server
Goblin: Noted. Want a migration checklist?
Operator: yes, by Friday

event-details.clause: keep concrete event details: names, numbers, dates
event-details.text:
Operator: my sister Marta's flight lands at Benito Juárez on 3 December at 18:40, AM 412
Goblin: Want a reminder an hour before?
Operator: yes

followed-event.clause: keep details of events the operator follows
followed-event.text:
Operator: the Artemis III launch slipped again, now targeting September 2027 according to NASA
Goblin: Want me to track updates?
Operator: yeah ping me if it moves

non-english.clause: extract in English, keep proper nouns verbatim
non-english.text:
Operator: el dentista en Coyoacán me cambió la cita al martes 25 de noviembre a las 11
Goblin: Anotado: martes 25 de noviembre, 11:00, Coyoacán.

mixed-noise.clause: keep the fact, drop the noise around it
mixed-noise.text:
Operator: haha nice one
Goblin: Thanks!
Operator: btw I started learning Rust, aiming to port the CLI by March
Goblin: Great choice. I'll find a few resources.
